QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` (`mbedtls_config.h:2109-2142`) are off by default.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the off-by-default MSan/valgrind constant-flow tests. It never says this facility is explicitly not part of the library API, and the item needs both.
